title: Auth delivery event (opaque webhook envelope, version 2026-10-27)
description: What a business receives for an auth.delivery.* event. Opaque by design (ADR-0025 section 5): ids, type, version, tenant and time. Never a magic link, code, TOTP seed, token, subject reference, variable or personal data. The business fetches the state with GET /v1/business/auth-deliveries/{request_id}. Signed with Viadere-Signature v2 only (never a v1= entry).

id.description: Stable across retries; also the Viadere-Event-Id header and the receiver's dedup key.

tenant_id.description: Must equal the receiver's own tenant id (the Viadere-Tenant header).

result_ref.description: Always absent for auth deliveries: no result is fetched, the business verifies its own link or code.
